email.title: Email integration
email.hint: Connect a shared inbox (Gmail, Outlook, FastMail, your provider) so candidate replies show up here and you can answer without leaving the app. Use an app password if your provider requires one.
email.loginHint: One login is used for both inbound (IMAP) and outbound (SMTP). Most providers require an app password rather than your account password — check your provider's docs.
email.starttlsHint: Off for port 465 (implicit TLS), on for 587 (STARTTLS).

matching.title: How matching works
matching.sender: Inbound mail is matched to candidates by sender address (case-insensitive).
matching.subject: If the sender is unknown, the subject line is scanned for a job title — e.g. "Re: Senior Product Designer — follow-up". The applicant whose name best matches the sender's name is picked.
matching.ignored: Senders that match neither a known address nor a job/applicant in the workspace are silently ignored.
matching.threading: When possible, replies thread under the existing candidate↔job conversation; otherwise a new thread is opened.
matching.outbound: Outbound replies sent from Vellum use the From identity above and thread via In-Reply-To headers.
matching.cadence: Polling cadence: {seconds}s. Run "Poll now" to fetch immediately.

calendar.invitesHint: When you schedule an interview, Vellum sends the candidate an email with a real <mono>.ics</mono> calendar attachment. They can open it in Gmail, Apple Calendar, Outlook or any other client and the event lands on their calendar with the right time, location, meeting link and attendees.
calendar.sendDefaultHint: The 'Send now' toggle in the Schedule modal defaults to this value. Recruiters can override per-meeting.

delivery.title: How invites are delivered
delivery.smtp: Outgoing mail uses your workspace's SMTP credentials from <link>Settings → Email</link>.
delivery.rfc: The .ics file follows RFC 5545 with method <mono>REQUEST</mono>, an event UID, and a 10-minute reminder.
delivery.cc: Picked interviewers are CC'd; their emails appear as ATTENDEES so clients show the full roster.
delivery.url: Meeting URL becomes the event's <mono>URL</mono> field — most clients render it as a Join button.
delivery.sequence: Re-sending an interview update bumps the iCalendar <mono>SEQUENCE</mono> so clients refresh in place instead of duplicating.
